query:
WITH me AS (
               SELECT COALESCE(
                   (SELECT experience FROM guild_member WHERE guild_id = $1 AND user_id = $2),
                   0
               ) AS xp
           )
           SELECT
               me.xp AS "experience!",
               (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM guild_member
                 WHERE guild_id = $1 AND experience > me.xp) AS "rank!"
           FROM me
